locations: Results: topoisomerase and putative transporter expression
qualitative_scope: The focal susceptibility results concern novobiocin and coumermycin A1 in laboratory derivatives of S. lividans TK24; donor-producer identities are separate.
Transport is proposed for NovA and CouR5, not directly measured in the inspected results.
The 2003 authors questioned the organism attribution of Z17304 and proposed rishiriensis rather than spheroides; this remains an attributed hypothesis, not a correction established here.
ParY enzymatic function was unresolved in this paper. The 2004 biochemical study is a distinct follow-up, not evidence that the 2003 study purified the resistant enzyme.
